description.text: The promotion for Pokémon's 25th anniversary. From 9 February 2021 in the United States, each Happy Meal held a pack of four cards, the first time customers there got four. The 25 cards are Pikachu and the first partner Pokémon of the eight regions. The promotion then went round the world through the year, Spain last in October 2021.
